name: com.mugen3d.mugenmorph
description: Drive ARKit-ready 3D characters with speech-synchronized facial animation via the Mugen3D MugenMorph API.

samples.description: Untextured ARKit_head.fbx in three scenes: HDRP (MugenMorph), URP (MugenMorph_URP), Built-in (MugenMorph_BuiltIn). Open the scene that matches the project pipeline. Git packages are read-only — import this sample (or use Tools → Mugen3D → Samples) so the scenes copy into Assets before you open them.
